summary_en: Nitto Denko approved acquisition of up to 17.0 million shares (2.58% of outstanding shares) for a maximum 50.0 billion yen through March 24, 2027, coupled with interim dividend of 36.0 yen and raised FY2027 year-end dividend forecast to 72.0 yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend Adjustment (Interim Dividend), Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Increase), and Share Repurchase Program
translation_en_brief:
Nitto Denko Corporation's board of directors resolved on October 27, 2026, to implement a share repurchase program and modify its dividend forecast. The company will acquire up to 17.0 million shares of its own stock, representing 2.58% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum expenditure of 50.0 billion yen. The acquisition period runs from November 4, 2026, through March 24, 2027. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 658.2 million shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock).

Simultaneously, Nitto Denko declared an interim dividend of 36.0 yen per share effective November 27, 2026, totaling 23.7 billion yen. The company raised its fiscal year 2027 year-end dividend forecast to 72.0 yen per share, up from the previously projected 32.0 yen, bringing the full-year dividend to 108.0 yen (36.0 yen interim plus 72.0 yen year-end), compared to 60.0 yen in the prior fiscal year.

The company cited its medium-term management plan "Nitto RISE 2028" and financial strategy framework as rationale. Management stated that the repurchase and dividend increase are aimed at enhancing shareholder returns, improving return on equity, and optimizing capital efficiency through maintaining appropriate liquidity and shareholder capital levels while advancing growth investments.
